visual_overrides.core_identity: An empty suit of medieval plate armor animated as one complete hollow construct, with no wearer or biological body inside.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Full articulated plate-armor silhouette moving as one hollow suit, with readable joints and dark empty gaps between plates.
visual_overrides.head_features: Closed or partly open helmet with empty darkness where a face would be; no eyes, flesh, skull, or wearer.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, greaves, and boots articulate as a complete suit rather than separate floating pieces.
